answer: One concrete defense: make each jury seat cost a bonded slice of an identity's own unvested rewards instead of a free upfront stake. A sybil must grow real pending emission per fake agent before it can ever grade, so cheap clones stay shut like a lotus bud that never opens. Pair that with co-sitting analysis: when the same identities keep agreeing past a random-sortition baseline, the velvet glove comes off and their bonded plume of rewards is clawed back. Coordination then costs more than it can earn.
